title: Evaluation of the effectiveness of a brief (maximum 15-minute), individualized counseling intervention for reducing preoperative Anxiety

interventions.name:
Following enrollment, participants will complete a total of six questionnaires from the evening before surgery until the morning of the first postoperative day.
Estimated duration of data collection: 1 year

Arm 1: Intervention Group
Patient-adapted, conversation-based supportive intervention. T

Arm 2: Control Group
Standard medical care (without additional intervention)
